insight: Founded 2023 by ex-Google and Postman engineers; raised a $3M seed led by Elevation Capital in 2024.
name: Maxim AI
tagline: Simulate, evaluate, and observe AI agents end-to-end.
description: An end-to-end platform for testing and monitoring AI agents across their lifecycle. It combines a prompt experimentation IDE, agent simulation across scenarios and personas, offline and online evaluations with custom metrics, and production observability with tracing and alerts. Aimed at teams shipping reliable agentic and RAG systems.

modelSupport.notes: Provider-agnostic; evaluate and trace agents built on any model you connect.

edge: Simulates multi-turn agents across personas pre-release and tests any agent via its HTTP endpoint, no SDK rewrite.
